changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwappointmentwaitinglist AS SELECT awl.id, awl.facility_id, awl.patient_id, awl.department_id, awl.service_id, awl.practitioner_id, awl.priority, awl.status, awl.preferred_date, awl.expected_duration_minutes, awl.reason, awl.notes, awl.booking_group_id, awl.booked_at, awl.created_by, awl.created_date, awl.last_modified_by, awl.last_modified_date FROM public.appointment_waiting_list awl;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwappointmentwaitinglist TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwappointmentwaitinglist FROM report_user;
